title: assonia stuhlmannii
intro: Assonia stuhlmannii, commonly known as the Assonia tree, is a species of flowering plant in the family Rubiaceae. It is a plant used in traditional medicine, valued for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, helping to relieve pain, reduce fever, and support immune function. The bioactive constituents of Assonia stuhlmannii include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
